name: initiate_asset_return
description: initiate_asset_return: Initiate a return authorization for a device being replaced. Generates a return shipping label and sets a 14-day return deadline. Returns the return instructions and deadline.

employee_id.description: The employee returning the device (e.g. EMP048271).

asset_tag.description: The asset tag of the device to return (e.g. AST-LPT-284719).

request_id.description: The hardware request ID associated with the replacement (e.g. REQ-HW-048271).
